subject: Sparkline POC outcomes — 15m spotlight & short quote?
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Powell <dana.powell@freshcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sparkline POC outcomes — 15m spotlight & short quote?

Hi Dana,

Thank you again for running the Sparkline POC with us — really appreciate the partnership and the clear test cases your team provided. I wanted to share a concise recap of the results and ask a small favor if FreshCart is open to it.

Key outcomes (3-week POC, production traffic subset):
- Avg inference latency dropped 42% (from 240ms to 139ms) for the top-10 routes.
- Response-quality uplift: intent extraction F1 +6 pts on your labeled sample.
- Backend API calls reduced 31% due to prefix/KV caching in the runtime (fewer round trips).
- Estimated unit cost improvement: ~28% lower per 1M tokens vs your current self-hosted baseline.

I put a short POC summary in the attached PDF and included the KPI sparkline chart (attached).

Would FreshCart be willing to do either of the two small things that help us tell this story?
1) A 10-15 minute call where we capture a 1-2 sentence quote about results/experience (we'll bring a draft).
2) Or, if easier, sign off on the one-line quote below and permission to publish the metrics snippet and logo.

DRAFT one-line quote for convenience: "Redwood Inference cut our latency and inference costs quickly during the POC with no disruption to our stack."

If you’re open, here’s my calendar: https://cal.com/irene/sparkline-15 — I’m happy to work around your preferred time.

Attachments: FreshCart_POC_Summary.pdf (summary), sparkline_kpi_chart.png

Thanks again,
Irene

Irene Choi
Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

---
Note: If you prefer a legal review before publishing metrics, we can include your legal team in the final review.

Irene,

This is fantastic — thanks for the clear summary and for making the draft quote easy. The team is pleased with the latency and cost improvements; those numbers track with what our analytics showed.

We are fine doing a quick 15-minute call to capture a short quote. My initial availability this week: Tue 4/21 10:00–11:30am PT or Wed 4/22 2:00–4:00pm PT. Feel free to grab a slot on your calendar link and I’ll invite anyone else internally as needed.

A couple of notes: please send the one-line quote to our legal team for a quick check before publishing (they usually just confirm accuracy). Also, can you add a sentence that calls out the integration effort was straightforward — that was important for our product team.

One-line (internal) approval for the draft quote: "Redwood reduced latency and simplified our deployment, delivering measurable cost savings in three weeks."

Happy to approve the quote pending legal review and the short call.

Best,
Dana
